plan.name: Keep sandbox output in order, and count markers mid-line
plan.summary: Every sandbox script that echoes step markers starts with `exec 2>&1`, so each step writes only to stdout and all of its output is in the run's output before the marker echoed after it: the Go sandbox and its agreement check one size larger, the TypeScript and Python sandboxes and their drivers' count one size larger, and the existing-TypeScript sandbox (internal/verify), and the plumbing sandbox (internal/plumbing). Docker carries a container's stdout and stderr apart and doesn't keep their order when it merges them, which is how #123's gate read `.......@@invariant test=0` and counted one step fewer. The marker patterns, `marker` in internal/verify/language.go and `markerLine` in internal/plumbing/sandbox.go, drop their start-of-line anchor: a marker counts wherever it is on its line, as long as it ends the line, and the text before it on that line belongs to the step it closes, so a step whose output ends without a newline is read right too. The steps, their exit codes and everything else read from the output (@@gofmt lines, test results, the explorer's count) stay as they are, and the comments on splitMarkers and pulled, which say a mid-line marker isn't found, are brought up to date.

tests.name: TestAMarkerAfterTextOnItsLineSplitsTheSame
tests.says: Sandbox output with its markers after other text on their lines, as in #123's `.......@@invariant test=0`, splits into the same sections, with the same exit codes, as the same output with each marker on a line of its own.

tests.name: TestEveryGateSandboxKeepsEachStepsOutputBeforeItsMarker
tests.says: With a fake Docker that hands over a run's stderr only after its stdout, what each step writes to stderr still lands in that step's own section, in the Go sandbox and its agreement check one size larger, and in the TypeScript, Python and existing-TypeScript sandboxes.

tests.name: TestAPlumbingMarkerAfterTextOnItsLineCountsTheSame
tests.says: The plumbing sandbox reads output with its markers after other text on their lines as it reads the same output with each marker on a line of its own: the same go vet and test results, and the same acceptance tests passed.

tests.name: TestThePlumbingSandboxKeepsEachStepsOutputBeforeItsMarker
tests.says: With a fake Docker that hands over a run's stderr only after its stdout, the plumbing sandbox's output still has what go vet, the tests and the acceptance tests wrote to stderr, each before its own marker.
